failure_cases.must_fail_when: a transaction operation has no sandbox fixture copy
fixture apply does not set proposed status
fixture apply changes frontmatter fields other than status
fixture rollback does not restore original copy SHA
rehearsal writes any old slice target file
rehearsal success is treated as user approval
rehearsal success allows real executor writes
rehearsal writes outside the p2-82 sandbox path
rehearsal creates mainline readiness, promotion, reviewed knowledge, evidence support, action basis, or goal completion
